What I confirmed before going lens-by-lens:

- The institutional setting in 2000: bicameral Congress with the Alianza holding the Chamber of Deputies and a fragmented Senate dominated by the PJ; Federal Supreme Court still carrying the Menem-era appointees (Helmke 2003, Alston & Melo 2007); a strong Peronist-controlled provincial/sub-national layer; Peronist-aligned CGT labor movement; mid-cycle economy.
